name: Drive Reads & Shooting
summary: Warm up your handle, shoot off a hop, read a help defender on the drive, then make free throws on tired legs.

drills.name: Dribble Tap Touches
drills.summary: Control the dribble while your off hand moves and your eyes stay up.
steps: Pound the ball hard at your right side.
Tap your left knee, then your left shoulder, then your head with your free hand.
Keep the dribble going the whole time.
Switch hands every 30 seconds.
Last minute, go faster and keep your chin up.

drills.name: Hop Gather Jumpers
drills.summary: Catch on a two-foot hop and rise into a balanced jumper.
steps: Start at the right elbow with the ball.
Spin the ball out a step in front of you.
Hop into the catch and land on both feet at once.
Rise straight up and shoot.
Move through five spots in the lane and midrange, then repeat.

drills.name: Help Step Drive Reads
drills.summary: Drive the lane and read if the help defender steps up or stays home.
steps: Start at the top of the key. Your partner stands on the weak-side block.
Drive hard toward the rim.
If your partner steps up into the lane, jump stop and pass to the spot they left.
If they stay home, finish the layup.
Partner mixes it up. No contact, just show the help.
Switch drive directions every rep.

drills.name: Wall Sit Pressure Free Throws
drills.equipment: 1 ball, 1 hoop, a wall or post
drills.summary: Burn your legs, then make free throws when you're tired.
steps: Wall sit for 30 seconds with knees at 90 degrees.
Walk straight to the free throw line.
Shoot two free throws using your full routine.
Keep track of your makes.
Repeat for four minutes and try to beat your score next time.
